title: Wrap, fasten and set down a folded umbrella
instruction: Wrap the loose tie around the folded umbrella, press it closed and lay the fastened umbrella on the table.
context: A collapsed umbrella can spring loose in a bag. The handle hand turns the bundle while the other keeps the fabric gathered, guides the tie and presses the fastener.
setup: Two YAM arms, an ordinary flat table and a folded compact umbrella with a 239 × 24 mm strap, a 55 mm hook region and a 72 mm loop region. The handle starts in the left gripper and the right gripper begins open.
scoring: Cumulative end-state score: 0.25 if gathered to ≤80% of loose diameter and held or supported; 0.50 with ≥4.7 rad of winding; 0.75 with a ≥360° guided turn, ≥365° winding and engaged, overlapping hook-and-loop; 1.00 after a controlled set-down with table support, both grippers ≥20 mm clear and one second of stillness.
reset_notes: Settle the preheld handle and freely hanging strap under gravity before the episode.
fidelity: A free shaft, twelve sprung canopy sections and fifteen hinged strap sections approximate folded fabric. Three hook segments can meet four loop segments. Patch overlap and measured normal load govern attachment; bonded areas can peel or shear apart. The demo reads simulator poses and contact forces. Table contact and clearance verify release. Material constants are uncalibrated.
